project_context.domain: Fabric Enquiry Tracking System / Internal SaaS

typography.typeset_rules: Strict adherence to line-height. Headings should be tight (leading-none or leading-tight). Body loose (leading-relaxed). Avoid Inter for headings.

spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: Control Room Grid (Dense, Data Correlation). Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12. Gap Strategy: gap-4 or gap-6. Every pixel must be utilized in dashboard overviews. No jagged bottoms, stretch children heights.
spacing_and_layout.container_padding: Generous. p-6 or p-8 inside cards with borders to prevent text collision.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: Subtle roundness. Use rounded-sm (4px) or rounded-md (6px). Avoid overly pill-shaped elements.

surface_strategies.dashboard_cards: Flat background (bg-white), 1px solid border (border-zinc-200), no shadow by default. On hover: subtle lift (-translate-y-0.5) and shadow-sm.
surface_strategies.headers: Crystal Glass variant: bg-white/80, backdrop-blur-xl, 1px bottom border border-zinc-200.
surface_strategies.empty_states: Tactile, subtle background textures or minimal graphic with centered clear CTA. Gray text, dashed borders.

components_strategy.shadcn_overrides: Use Shadcn components heavily but customize them. Strip default shadows, replace with flat sharp borders. Override Tabs to have sharp bottoms.
components_strategy.forms: Use pure HTML + Tailwind for macro layouts. Shadcn for Inputs, Select, Checkbox. Focus rings must be ring-1 ring-zinc-900 offset-1.
components_strategy.tables: Dense. border-collapse. Subdued header backgrounds (bg-zinc-50), clear bottom borders per row.
components_strategy.badges: Use sharp corners (rounded-sm). Match status colors for text and background.

navigation.structure: Sidebar navigation (collapsible on mobile to hamburger) containing Logo, Links (Dashboard, Enquiries, Master Stages, Users), and Profile Dropdown at bottom.
navigation.active_state: Solid gray background (bg-zinc-100) with bold text for active link. Muted text for inactive.

interactions_motion.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. High contrast focus rings mandatory.

brand_logo.description: Abstract industrial logo mark, sharp geometric woven threads, minimal, monochrome black

login_bg.description: Minimalist pure white and light grey woven fabric macro texture background

texture_accent.description: Textured yellow fabric folds for subtle empty state or accent backgrounds

testing_requirements.data_testid_rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute. Format: kebab-case, role-based. e.g., data-testid='enquiry-submit-button', data-testid='stage-status-badge'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Import custom fonts (Cabinet Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans) using Google Fonts or local font face rules in index.css.
Use Shadcn UI for heavy lifting (Tables, Dialogs, Selects, Cards) but apply the custom flat border styles (border-radius: 4px, border-color: #E4E4E7).
Build a Left Sidebar Layout. Main area uses background #F4F4F5. Cards inside main area use #FFFFFF.
Create the Enquiries Table with heavy filtering capabilities. Display Custom Stages clearly using the status color mapping.
Implement an Admin Dashboard with widgets showing metrics like Total Enquiries, By Stage, and By Department. Use the 'Control Room Grid' pattern.
Ensure login page uses the provided login_bg image as a subtle background, with a sharp white central login card.
Add data-testid to every button, link, and major block.
